title: Moon Landing Lemon Drizzle Cake
ingredients: For the drizzle: juice of 1½ lemons and 85 g caster sugar
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Line a 900 g loaf tin with baking paper.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale and creamy, then add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each.
Sift in the flour, add the lemon zest and mix until combined. Spoon into the tin and level the top.
Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, until a skewer pushed into the centre comes out clean.
Mix the lemon juice and sugar. Prick the warm cake all over and pour the drizzle over it. Leave to cool in the tin.
